description: Na₂Hf(MoO₄)₃ is Zircon-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.89 Å. Hf is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Hf-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.38 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.76 Å) and two longer (1.85 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.36 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Mo atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Hf and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one Mo atom.
